## 2. Avoid

- **Also avoid:** Unpublished claims of novelty; burying the publication list

## 3. Types that do not apply

- **Data store:** not screened for research roles
- **Protocol / standard:** no protocol requirements in the evidence
- **Regulation / framework:** not part of this role
- **Business & product:** business framing is not assessed in research loops

## 4. Credentials (tie-breakers, not skills)

- None recommended.

## 5. Prerequisites and proof

- **Prerequisites:** PhD plus publications; frontier offers are "not plannable" [D · T0-06].
- **Proof to show:** Papers, open research code, talks.
- **Posting terms (measured or cited):** Python (42.3%), communication (41.3%), machine learning (39.2%), PyTorch (25.4%), LLM (24.4%), deep learning (18.6%), C++ (17.4%), reinforcement learning (17.1%).
